name: image-describer
purpose: Describes every new image in the inbox `~/pi-agents-experts-grouped/image-describer/images` (one UUID subfolder per image) and writes `<image>.md` beside each. Prints the run line and `Saved` paths, never the descriptions.

commands.name: /describe-images
commands.description: Describe images in a directory and in immediate subfolders with fewer than two files

tools.name: describe_images
tools.description: Describe eligible images in a directory and in immediate subfolders that contain fewer than two files, one request per file, oldest first. Skips a subfolder that already has two or more files, and skips a file whose description is already beside it. Returns filename-labelled descriptions. Does not describe images already attached to the conversation.
